176800.overview: An Arkanoid\Breakout clone, compiled with Abacus Software's BASIC 128 v1.00 and presented in 40 columns. In this version the paddle is on the left side of the screen.

219097.overview: A game from the the Brett Games 128 compilation and then and later released by CA Verlags in Commodore Disc #4. Mühle has been around for 3000 years, 9 white stones and 9 black stones and try to put 3 in a row. 3D Mühle proves that technological progress even in the face of the oldest traditions does not stop.

448871.overview: The Seven Doctors (or The Seven Doctors) is a z-machine based text adventure based on The popular BBC Science Fiction series Doctor Who. The original was written by David Burke in 2018. The Commodore 128 version was converted by Lee Burt via a Z-Machine conversion application in 2023 and can be played in 40 or 80 columns. In this game you play the seventh incarnation of The Doctor. Various enemies have kidnapped and imprisoned your other six previous incarnations, and it's up to you to save each and every one of them, for if you don't your death becomes a fixed point in time.
